text:
Sam: Heads up — found a config where someone tried to be edgy with semver. Copy-paste horror below.
Sam: ```yaml
service:
  name: widgetizer
  version: "1.0..0"
```
Jing: is that two dots or a Morse code for 'we tried'? :grimacing:
Ravi: that's the 'I refactored at 3am' version
build-bot: ⚠️ publish blocked — invalid version "1.0..0". Did you mean 1.0.0? See https://semver.org/
Maya: can we add a rule: no consecutive punctuation in versions? :laughing:
Sam: +1 also a rule: no poetry in config files
Jing: propose auto-correct to 1.0.0, or we could interpret it as '1.0 to infinity' and ship it as a feature :rocket:
Ravi: sticker idea: 'I survived semver' for the comms board
Sam: also adding an in-repo meme: 'You had one job — version.' :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
build-bot: CI note: applied fixup branch 'fix/semver-sherlock' created
Maya: :thumbsup: merging after green tests
Sam: thanks team — mystery solved.
